summary: @servicetitan/anvil-token 0.4.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<arch>.zip`), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript file (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are heavily obfuscated using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` rotator over a large numeric/char-code table) — not human-readable and undocumented. This executes automatically on `npm install`. The package's documented purpose is shipping design-token JSON theme files, which requires no runtime code execution; the bundled CHANGELOG.md stops at v0.4.0 (March 2024) and does not describe the preinstall hook, setup.mjs, or math_init.js that appear in this 0.4.4 tarball, indicating the lifecycle-executed payload was added outside the package's documented release history. The Bun runtime is used to run attacker-supplied obfuscated code that would otherwise be visible to Node-based tooling; delivery of a runtime plus an opaque payload as an install-time side effect of a design-tokens package is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
